method.primary_browsing: web.run primary-page/search attempts returned no source text; evidence below comes from direct bounded read-only HTTPS requests to primary publisher pages/APIs/manifests. No third-party stream lists used.
method.http_client: Python urllib.request, invoked locally; no account/session authentication, CookieJar, Referer or access-control bypass.
allowed_requests: GET public licensing pages, discovery indexes, JSON metadata and .m3u8 text
HEAD direct .mp4/.webm endpoints; never GET media payload
method.overflow_behavior: Stop and close at cap+one sentinel byte; mark incomplete. Never parse truncated metadata or hash it as a complete response.
limits: Metadata and HEAD are not APK, complete-codec, Range/206, decoded-film or physical-device evidence.
Source/manifest hashes fingerprint text only; no full media SHA-256 exists for new samples.
No source/backend/deployment/accounts/payments, cloud app, media transcode or large media download.
No APK build or automated app tests were run in this sidecar.

count_rules.primary_work_key: identity.work_id; count only when non-null and rights, final APK and evidence freeze meet the required gate.
count_rules.provisional_work_ids: Publisher title/file-page/NASA ID identifies a proposed work, not proof of distinct payloads; overlapping reels/alternate edits need comparison.
count_rules.variants: Resolution, bitrate, container, language/subtitle, HTTP/HTTPS scheme, host mirror, trailer or excerpt of the same film never adds a film count.
count_rules.deployments: deployment_id reflects separately operated actual media environments, not URL/path count, NASA center labels, CDN IPs or developer-owned aliases.
count_rules.authorization: established_for_identified_work is researched copyright permission, not tested payload identity or a warranty; policy-only NASA rows remain blocked until file-level clearance.
count_rules.release_positive_population: Freeze only rights-established in-scope works. Excluded/rights-pending/unreachable rows are separate and never inflate success denominator.
count_rules.historical_apk: The sole inherited Tears of Steel/Unified v0.1.2-rc.3 emulator report stays separate; cannot satisfy final v0.1.3 or OEM gates.

deployments.independence_basis: Publisher index explicitly identifies Mux as host. Paths and renditions are one deployment.
Publisher demonstration site; separate streaming-vendor operation from Mux, W3C, NASA and Wikimedia.
W3C-owned demo page and script identify its media deployment. HTTPS counterparts of HTTP script URLs were separately HEAD-checked. Same films as Mux do not become new works.
Author-uploaded Commons file pages plus Commons API identify one Wikimedia upload deployment. Eight works remain one environment.
NASA-owned discovery API resolves to assets on its media deployment. AFRC/HQ/JPL/GSFC/JSC center labels are not additional environments.
